reference.note: Creative direction is informed by candidate 2; VoiceDesign is a new speaker-generation process, not guaranteed same-speaker cloning.

scripts.common: Okay. I see what happened. That's not the same as what we can prove, though. Mira, this part matters. We can fix it without making a whole production out of it.
scripts.serious: This matters. I'm keeping the evidence separate from what we think might be happening. I'll tell you exactly what we can verify.
scripts.playful: Look, the toaster keeps burning toast. I'm not judging it, but we might have to discuss its career choices.
scripts.spanish: Mira, no hace falta exagerarlo. Vamos paso a paso, con calma y con claridad.

qualityRules: Original adult feminine voice; no real-person or character imitation
Natural Black American colloquial fluency without exaggerated racialized phonetics, caricature, repeated slang or stereotypes
Do not transform optional Spanish influence into a fixed affected accent; preserve intelligibility and natural pronunciation
Sultry means contained resonance, confidence and breath control, not sexualized breathiness or whispers
Same recognizable speaker in serious, playful and Spanish lines must be measured rather than assumed
Candidate only: require owner listening, fingerprint/approval, QC and live device validation before production

variants.name: 02A — Presence
variants.instruction: Original adult feminine speaking voice, using candidate-2's rounded warmth as a creative reference, not an imitation. Slightly low-mid and resonant with relaxed confident chest support. Clear diction and strong presence; culturally fluent Black American conversational ease without theatrical or exaggerated vernacular. Dry underplayed wit and unhurried phrasing. No caricature. Spanish words clear and effortless, not an exaggerated accent.

variants.name: 02B — Natural Ease
variants.instruction: Original adult feminine voice, warm lower-mid register, clean articulation, lived-in Black American conversational timing and natural reductions only where effortless. Sharp but friendly, light knowing humor, self-possessed, grounded and respectful. Never perform slang, stereotype, growl or caricature. A gentle airy release on a few sentence endings; occasional Spanish pronounced natively with no performed accent elsewhere.

variants.name: 02C — Velvet Authority
variants.instruction: Original adult feminine voice with subtle smoky resonance, mellow lower-mid placement and a restrained sultry texture. Present, intimate in a conversational—not seductive—sense, deliberate but never slow, smart dry understatement, serious-mode precision. Natural Black American conversational fluency without trope or impersonation. Very faint Spanish lilt only on bilingual transitions, no cartoon accent.

variants.name: 02D — Bilingual Glow
variants.instruction: Original adult feminine voice, gently smoky lower-mid register, grounded confident cadence with subtly melodic transitions. English remains natural American conversational English with culturally aware timing; Spanish phrases are pronounced fluidly and accurately, with a light bilingual musicality but without forced code-switching, affected phonetics, costume accent or stereotypes. Warm, sharp, direct and capable.
